about_the_game:
Gabriel, a middle-aged man isolated in the depths of his own mind, awakens in a strange and desolate world. To escape, he must confront powerful entities—manifestations of his fear, guilt, and painful memories.

This atmospheric action game challenges players with intense, one-on-one encounters against symbolic bosses. With minimalist mechanics and a focus on timing, observation, and precision, every fight is a test of both skill and understanding.

Explore a haunting landscape shaped by emotion and memory. Piece together fragments of Gabriel’s past as you uncover the reasons behind his solitude—and whether there is a way out.

Features:

  • Tight, focused combat with high-stakes encounters

  • Symbolic bosses representing psychological themes

  • A solitary journey through surreal, emotional environments

  • Minimal UI and storytelling through the world itself

  • Atmospheric soundtrack and visual style

Prepare to confront the monsters within — and discover whether redemption lies at the end of the mind’s labyrinth.

Recommended:
